parts.visual:
You launched an app for dog walkers. For 6 months, nobody downloaded it. The data proves your business model is a total failure. You have $500k left in the bank. Do you quit?

The Mechanism of Survival:
1. The Pivot: A structured, fundamental change in a startup's business strategy, product, or target market, based on validated learning that the original idea is dead.
2. The Reality: Twitter started as a podcasting app (Odeo). Slack started as a video game (Glitch). The greatest companies in the world survived by pivoting.
parts.audio: A Pivot is not a failure; it is a feature of the Lean Startup methodology. It is a rapid, calculated change in direction when the data proves that your original business hypothesis was wrong.

questions.question: A startup sells an expensive AI tool for enterprise companies, but the sales cycle takes 12 months and the startup is running out of money. They realize small businesses will buy a cheaper version in 5 minutes online. They completely redesign the software for small businesses. What is this called?
options: A Customer Segment Pivot. They kept the core technology but fundamentally changed who they were selling it to in order to survive.
questions.correct_answer: A Customer Segment Pivot. They kept the core technology but fundamentally changed who they were selling it to in order to survive.
questions.explanation: A pivot can be a change in the product, the customer, the price, or the distribution channel.

questions.question: Listen to the founder. Why is she executing a 'Zoom-In Pivot'?
questions.tts_text: We built a massive social network with a thousand features, but nobody uses it. Except for the photo-sharing feature. That one button is getting a million clicks a day. We are deleting the rest of the app and focusing 100% on photos.
options: A Zoom-In Pivot happens when a single feature of a complex product becomes the entire product. They are stripping away the noise to double down on what actually works.
questions.correct_answer: A Zoom-In Pivot happens when a single feature of a complex product becomes the entire product. They are stripping away the noise to double down on what actually works.
questions.explanation: This is exactly how Instagram was created. It started as a complex app called Burbn.

questions.question: Why is 'Ego' the biggest enemy of a successful Pivot?
options: Because pivoting requires the founder to look at their investors and their team and say: 'I was wrong. My grand vision failed.' Founders with massive egos will ride a sinking ship to the bottom rather than admit defeat.
Ego is actually good for pivoting.
questions.correct_answer: Because pivoting requires the founder to look at their investors and their team and say: 'I was wrong. My grand vision failed.' Founders with massive egos will ride a sinking ship to the bottom rather than admit defeat.
questions.explanation: You must kill your own darling ideas before the market kills your company.

questions.question: What is the worst possible outcome for a failing startup?
options: The 'Zombie Startup'. They refuse to pivot, but they have just enough revenue to survive. They don't grow, they don't die, they just exist in a state of eternal mediocrity for ten years, wasting everyone's time.
questions.correct_answer: The 'Zombie Startup'. They refuse to pivot, but they have just enough revenue to survive. They don't grow, they don't die, they just exist in a state of eternal mediocrity for ten years, wasting everyone's time.
questions.explanation: In Silicon Valley, failing fast is better than failing slow.
